fields.description: The exact fieldname on the mapped doctype (not its label) -- e.g. "discrepancy_amount", not "Discrepancy Amount".
fields.label: Doctype Field

fields.description: A Sheet column LETTER only (e.g. "D") -- header text is not supported.
fields.label: Sheet Column

fields.description: If unchecked, this field is pushed to the Sheet (Alaiy OS -> Sheets) but an edit to its cell in the Sheet is never written back -- issue #8's field-level permission mapping. Unchecked is the safe default so a new field never becomes writable from the Sheet by accident.
fields.label: Editable from Sheet
